typography.headings_font: Barlow Condensed / Outfit / sans-serif (Bold, high impact uppercase overlines)
typography.body_font: Inter / System Sans (High legibility, clear data scanning)
typography.code_mono_font: JetBrains Mono / Source Code Pro (For specifications, pressure ratings, tolerance details)

scale_hierarchy.h1_hero: text-4xl sm:text-5xl lg:text-6xl font-extrabold tracking-tight leading-none

colors.theme_mode: Dark Industrial Precision (Navy/Slate Base with Steel Blue & Safety Amber/Cyan Accents)
colors.gradient_rules: No soft rainbow gradients. Use technical directional subtle glows, radial spot lights on card hover, or solid metallic borders.

surface_and_lighting.nav_header: Backdrop-blur-md bg-slate-900/90 border-b border-slate-800 text-white z-50 fixed top-0 width-full
surface_and_lighting.cards: bg-slate-900/80 border border-slate-800 hover:border-cyan-500/50 transition-all duration-300 rounded-lg p-6 relative overflow-hidden group
surface_and_lighting.buttons: Pill or crisp 4px rounded buttons. Primary: bg-cyan-600 hover:bg-cyan-500 text-white font-semibold py-3 px-6 shadow-lg shadow-cyan-950/50 transition-all active:scale-95. Secondary: border border-slate-700 hover:bg-slate-800 text-slate-200.
surface_and_lighting.modals: Enquiry popup overlay bg-black/80 backdrop-blur-sm, modal content bg-slate-900 border border-slate-700 text-white max-w-lg shadow-2xl rounded-xl p-6 md:p-8

layout_and_bento.hero_section: Asymmetric bento / split screen: Left side text intro + CTA buttons + quick stats badge, Right side interactive technical product preview / high quality industrial machinery render
layout_and_bento.stats_bar: 4-column grid (grid-cols-2 md:grid-cols-4) with metric counters: 100% Leak Proof, 10,000+ PSI Rated, 500+ Industrial Clients, 100+ Custom Components
layout_and_bento.products_grid: 3-column grid (grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-2 lg:grid-cols-3) featuring major product categories with spec chips, download brochure links, and instant inquiry triggers
layout_and_bento.about_grid: Split visual section with CNC machining video/photo backdrop, quality certificates, material grades (SS 316, SS 304, Monel, Hastelloy, Inconel)
layout_and_bento.contact_section: Dual layout with direct Google map placeholder / address block, direct phone & email action cards, and responsive interactive quote request form

motion_and_animations.page_transitions: Fade-in with slight vertical slide up (y: 20 to 0, opacity: 0 to 1)
motion_and_animations.scroll_reveal: Staggered reveal for grid items with viewport once configuration
motion_and_animations.hover_effects: Card glow borders, subtle scale (1.02), icon pulse
motion_and_animations.floating_whatsapp: Fixed bottom-right button with pulsing pulse animation ring for high visibility
motion_and_animations.enquiry_popup: Triggered via header CTA, hero CTA, card 'Inquire Now' buttons, and floating bottom-left button

Connect the enquiry form to backend API endpoint POST /api/enquiries with toast notifications on submission success.
Include detailed product search/filter by category on the Products page.
